# Cristian Correa (cris.fast)

Last updated: 2026-08-03

## About
- [Full profile (markdown)](https://cris.fast/llms-full.txt): bio, experience, projects, stack, and contact — canonical LLM-readable source.

## Currently
- [Croma](https://usecroma.com): Founder. API for government data.
- [Crafter Station](https://crafterstation.com): Product engineering.

## Primary project
- [Kebo](https://kebo.app): Open-source AI agent for personal finance. 100k+ users in LATAM, 30k MAU. Founder, 2024–2026.

## Other projects
- [The Hackathon Company](https://www.hackathon.lat): Build amazing hackathons with friends and great sponsors.
- [Maca](https://maca.sh): Blazing-fast voice-to-text desktop tool.
- [C3](https://c3.crafter.run): Open-source multi-model AI chat (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok).
- [LaTeX0](https://latex0.crafter.run): AI-native LaTeX editor.
- [SQL4All](https://sql4all.org): Free interactive SQL learning for Spanish speakers, PGlite in the browser.
- [DAG Sketch](https://dag.cris.fast): Design and visualize Airflow DAGs from YAML.
